description: Espacialização dos dados do Instituto Mineiro de Gestão das Águas de Minas Gerais - IGAM is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Informações espacializadas das propriedades aquícolas no estado de Minas Gerais. Dados solicitados via ofício e cedidos pelo Instituto Mineiro de Gestão Das Águas De Minas Gerais. [CNPASA]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are aquicultura, banco de dados espaciais, CNPASA, igam, Minas Gerais. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
